description: pocketcall's hook. When Claude Code is about to ask for permission and this computer is paired (scripts/remote.py) and marked away, the approval card goes to the phone - the company relay's page and the company's messenger - with Yes, No and Show the diff; the first answer decides. At the desk or not paired it prints nothing and the ordinary dialog appears. It goes through the step 0 guard and stays quiet without Python. The board hooks (UserPromptSubmit, Notification, PostToolUse, Stop, SessionEnd) write each session's state - working, waits for you, done, resting on a limit until a given hour - to ~/.pocketcall/board (scripts/board.py) and ring the phone on what changed for the person; they print nothing and never stop the session.

hooks.command:
exec sh "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/python.sh" pocketcall quiet "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/approve_hook.py"
trap { continue }; & ([scriptblock]::Create((Get-Content -Raw -LiteralPath "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/python.ps1"))) pocketcall quiet "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/approve_hook.py"
